task: Compare guarded Faherty native content capture using provider defaults, remove the demonstrated timeout override failure, and verify private R2 capture without changing budgets/scoring/frontend.
nonGoals: No frontend, shared dependencies, rubric changes, new services, paid add-ons or unrelated Cloudflare resources.
No increase to 60% account ceilings or 1000 ms CPU cap; no bypass of native capture/global/R2 guards.
No fabricated initial-response evidence, silent truncation or unverified provider lifetime guarantee.

outcomes.description: Perform one guarded live content call using exactly {url} in an inactive version of the existing Worker and capture native HTTP/error/usage evidence. Choose provider defaults if capture succeeds; keep the existing application deadline and error on late/oversized responses. Version the retrieval cache identity.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen request/default regression, retained HTML roundtrip, existing timeout/provider/error/size tests; private native response evidence.

outcomes.description: After required checks and independent review, deploy the reviewed backend only and verify one real Faherty HTML object in private R2 by byte size, hash and product markers with 24-hour expiry. Report any model/assessment limitations separately from successful capture. If live evidence requires provider-envelope compatibility, accept only documented metadata while keeping unknown fields honest.
outcomes.evidence: PR/CI, active version/hash/CPU1000, provider usage settlement, private R2 object and D1 integrity evidence; primary API docs.

process.description: Separate planning commit, isolated codex worktree, frozen deterministic tests, actual source-bound evaluation, independent Terra review and hosted CI before merge/deploy. Keep merchant HTML, secrets and raw private artifacts out of Git.
process.evidence: Commit history, review, run/trace/handoff, PR and private validation artifacts.

styleEfficiency.description: Keep the change to native capture settings and directly required compatibility. One native call then R2 storage; reuse existing bindings and avoid request interception or extra browser sessions.

exitTest.reason: Only native request settings/response validation change; retained storage representation and resumability protocol remain unchanged. Existing fresh-agent R2 replay from PR45 remains regression coverage, not a new exit-test claim.

context: Provider returned HTTP422 error6002 timeout under custom networkidle2/navigation20000/action5000. User authorizes default request comparison, targeted fix, deployment and Faherty R2 verification while preserving all cost and ownership boundaries.
